# Known bugs

<!-- Convention: informal; a table of the known defects (date, where, symptom, status). Generated by code-quality-suite (git repo-files); edit freely. -->

Bugs found and not yet fixed. A bug found in a released version is added here first
(`git bug-conocido`) and the row reaches every open branch; the fix then updates or
removes the row.

Status: `open`; `fixing: <branch>`; `deferred: <version>`.

| Date | Where | Symptom | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2026-11-23 | `ai-init.sh`, `qs-run.sh` | python3 missing on Windows (only `python`): settings.json silently never generated | fixing: 7.1.1/cleanup/python_cmd |
| 2026-11-15 | gate, other temp-copy tools | juliaformatter, mh-style, bicep-format, ktlint, rubocop, sqlfluff... may lose project config in check mode | deferred: documented in TROUBLESHOOTING |
| 2026-11-14 | first push to GitHub | pre-push found 328 pre-existing gate findings in 268 files | deferred: baseline cleanup 6.1.x |
| 2026-11-16 | `children_pending` (git-flow-lib.sh) | counts SPIKE, REVIEW and CHECKPOINT children as pending, so they block their node ORIGINAL from integrating | open: filter them when the creator branches land |
| 2026-11-21 | `install.sh` / image cleanup (`qs_clean_old_images`) | an install of one version deletes the images of every other version on the machine | open: keep images still used by local repositories or branches |
| 2026-11-21 | release with repo-local aliases | aliases and hooks run the scripts of the checked-out branch; on an old ORIGINAL the old scripts fail (`unknown option --ot`) and the OT release deletes the branch holding the new scripts | open: worked around by releasing from a detached HEAD at the tip |
| 2026-11-21 | `git ia` settings merge (ai-init.sh, settings-merge.py) | breaks in a worktree (`.git` is a file); BOM or comments abort `git ia`; a retired suite row equal to a user deny row is dropped; duplicates kept | fixing: 6.0.0/special/permissions |
| 2026-11-21 | OT release tag (`ot/<v>/<ot>`) | the public tag list mixes OT tags with version tags; only version-number tags are wanted | open: worked around with a hidden ref (`refs/ot/...`); code fix before the 6.0.0 release |
| 2026-11-21 | `si_merge_refusal` (special-integra.sh) | the refusal names the branch twice; a fast-forward merge skips pre-merge-commit | open (low) |
| 2026-11-21 | `qs_publish_rename` (autopublish) | the atomic rename falls back to delete-old then push-new; if the new name is refused, origin loses the branch | fixing: 6.0.0/special/autopublish |
| 2026-11-21 | `special_path_match` (hooks rules) | forks a subshell per glob and file: about 0.25 s per file on Git Bash (200 files = 51 s) | fixing: 6.0.0/special/hooks_rules |
| 2026-11-22 | `bootstrap.sh` / `qs-init.sh` run `install.sh` directly | the index stores install.sh and bootstrap.sh as 100644 (core.fileMode=false on Windows): on a Linux checkout `git iniciar` fails with "Permission denied" | open (medium): set the mode in the index or run them through bash |
| 2026-11-22 | `git release --ot` precheck | an integrated final that was rebased locally keeps a patch-equivalent copy on origin; the OT release refuses "local and origin diverged" | deferred: 7.2.1 (accept a branch whose origin copy is patch-equivalent) |
| 2026-11-22 | `git publicar --version` | the develop commit and the tag were made locally but origin kept the old state | open: to investigate in 7.2.1 |
